It is found at random when identifying ancient remains.

The barrows-dyed augmented blightbound crossbow is a level 92 Ranged off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Blightbound crossbow (Barrows), or by using Barrows dye on an augmented blightbound crossbow.

The ice-dyed augmented off-hand blightbound crossbow is a level 92 Ranged off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Off-hand blightbound crossbow (ice), or by using Ice dye on an augmented off-hand blightbound crossbow.

Gemstone Wings (Emerald).x: Gemstone Wings (Emerald) is a wings slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Gemstone Wings. It matches the emerald golem outfit, though unlike the outfit the wings are purely cosmetic and offer no benefits.

Golden hammer.x: The golden hammer is a reward from using a golden cracker on another player. This item was released on 20 December 2010.

Greater Salvation Wings.x: Greater Salvation Wings are an override obtained by cremating 350 vyre corpses in the Columbarium below Paterdomus.

sc: The Rocky Halo appearance token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that unlock the Rocky pet during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
Requiring 75 Attack to wield, it is created by attaching a Saradomin hilt to a completed godsword blade by either using the items on each other or smithing them at an anvil.
The player must obtain four different notes for the quest by killing Skeletons, Dried zombies and Scabarites north of the archaeologist camp, or Mummies to the west.
The seers' ring is one of the Fremennik rings, and is dropped by Dagannoth Prime in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon.
Mages with less money can use the beacon ring, which is obtained in What Lies Below, or the TokKul-Zo which is obtained from the Elder Kiln quest.
It can be found by searching the bookcase on the eastern wall in Raz's hut.
It is a pocket slot equippable item obtained from the Bandosian recruiter when joining the Bandos forces in the Bird and the Beast world event.
It can also be re-obtained at May's Quest Caravan after putting 150 quest points (only after previously owning it).
Smite (Tier 0) is obtained as a drop from each faction's minions in the Battle of Lumbridge.
It could be obtained by storing summoning scrolls in a Snakeskin bandana (e).
The soul cape (blood) is an item received by defeating the Memory of Nomad in under eight minutes.
It can be obtained on a reward run and on a non-reward run.

sc: The spell scroll is a scroll received as a reward from the Watchtower quest.
If the player loses the scroll before reading it, they can speak to the Watchtower Wizard to obtain another one.

Supreme growth potion (fruity) is a type of growth potion which can be bought alongside other growth potions from the Farmers' Market or Ranch Out of Time branch for 2,400 beans, or from Sydekix's Shop of Balance for 18,000 Crux Eqal favour.

Tempest Lord Platelegs (static).x: The Tempest Lord Platelegs (static) are a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Tempest Lord Armour (static) set. They are unlocked alongside their combat reactive variant.

sc: Tracking gloves are a pair of ranged gloves dropped by the Automaton Generators that can be found in the Guthixian temple after completing The World Wakes.
The uncharted island map is an item that can be randomly obtained when gaining experience outside the Arc.
Players can only find a new uncharted island map if they do not already have one in the backpack or bank, and can obtain only one per two days.
The united Barrows necroplasm is an item created by searching the chest in the Barrows with all of the other brothers' necroplasm in your backpack.
Each brother's necroplasm is obtained by first killing them and then using 20 greater necroplasm on their sarcophagus.
The Valkyrie Staff is a two-handed magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased, along with the rest of the Valkyrie Outfit, for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
Vellum is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 24 Archaeology, at various dig sites around RuneScape.
In real life, is a parchment-like material made from cured animal skin.

Weapon poison++ flask.x: The weapon poison++ flask is a potion flask containing six doses of weapon poison++. It is created by using weapon poison++ potions on a potion flask.
